APPROVE
The extracted helpers preserve the original logic, including bounds checks, short-circuit order, the `k` passed to `FunctionBodyAfter`, and lazy `yield` semantics, and moving the loop body out should leave `Next` well under 15. I couldn't compile it here because the repo isn't available, so the parameter type names (`Model`, `Lexed`, `JsToken`, `IReadOnlyList<JsToken>`) are unchecked.
